THE CEILING opens: larder rung 3, and C.3 is RULED.

Nathan ruled the underworld-larder metaplan's open design question -- The Winze amendment C.3, which the metaplan records as "Nathan has not ruled" -- on 2026-09-11: SYMMETRIC BUDGET, ASYMMETRIC ALLOCATION. One budget with two kinds of consumer, so C.3's mechanism claim stands: a spreading horror and a spreading ecology eat the same rock. But COMPOSITION decides the split, not magnitude.

RATIONALE. C.3 stated its own cost as "barren and deadly" and "lush and safe" both becoming unreachable world-types. That was written 2026-08-24 and predates THE SOURCES, which measured that magnitude COMPRESSES underground -- roughly three near-constant categorical states -- and that variety survives in COMPOSITION, i.e. which mechanism dominates rather than how much arrives. If that holds, C.3's stated cost dissolves. This is a HYPOTHESIS, not a result. Preregistering and measuring it is The Ceiling's job.

BOUNDARY WITH THE TIDEMARK, accepted exactly as that campaign wrote it in its spec section 7 and ledger #5. The Tidemark keeps the MARINE half of rung 4: the vent commensal weights CHEMOSYNTHATE and consumes marine_chemosynthate_supply_field. The Ceiling takes rung 3 only, and authors NO marine kind, touches NO TrophicMode, and gives NO Surface-realm kind a CHEMOSYNTHATE weight.

WHY THIS POST EXISTS. The registry row BIO-chemotrophy says rung 4 is "THE TENANT's job". A campaign named The Tenant DID run, on 2026-08-30 -- it minted decision 0516 about chamber locks and keys, is unrelated to the larder, and left no spec, plan, ledger, chronicle, retrospective or reconciliation row. Two sessions have now independently spent effort answering "did The Tenant close?" by looking where one would look and finding nothing. The answer: that name is taken by an unrelated decision-only landing, and the larder rung 4 it appears to name is now split between The Tidemark (marine, live) and a successor (underworld).
